name: klarion
description: Finds secrets in code and has a model decide which ones are real.
long_description: Klarion flags candidate secrets with curated provider rules and a Rényi-entropy sweep, then adjudicates each candidate with a model so placeholders, fixtures and identifiers do not reach you. Configure an API key and Klarion judges. Configure nothing and it returns each candidate with its decision rules for the agent that called it to judge.

tools.name: scan_text
tools.description: Scan text or source code for leaked secrets before writing it.

tools.name: scan_file
tools.description: Scan a file on disk for leaked secrets before committing it.

tools.name: verify_finding
tools.description: Adjudicate one candidate secret: real leak or false positive.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API key
anthropic_api_key.description: Optional. With a key Klarion judges each candidate itself. Without one it returns the candidates and its decision rules for your agent to judge.
